title: Unique generator-normalized transport of completed constant modules
statement: For a scheme X, an adic coefficient datum d over a commutative ring A, and a scheme automorphism e, let C be the completed constant-module functor and H the module pullback using the coefficient comparison conjugated by the finite-quotient presentation of def-wf-tensor-unit-square-data. There is a unique natural isomorphism C ⋙ H ≅ C whose composite with the actual pullback-adjunction unit sends each constant generator 1 tensor x on U to 1 tensor x on e-base-change(U). No freeness, finiteness, or flatness is assumed on the A-module.

proof.text: Conjugate the completed scalar direct-image square by the finite-quotient ring comparison.

Compose the constant/global-sections adjunction with scalar extension. The unit is the actual generator 1 tensor x. The scalar square identifies direct-image global sections with sections on the base-changed object by identity maps.

Use uniqueness of left adjoints to construct the comparison. Its unit formula gives normalization at the terminal object; naturality gives normalization on every object. The two adjunction bijections also give uniqueness.
